description:
This file contains definitions for device-specific build configurations and image assembly rules for Layerscape ARMv7-based devices, using a Makefile syntax.
It defines device profiles, image creation procedures, device-specific parameters, and target device configurations.

methods.name: Device/Default
methods.description: Defines default device build and image parameters such as profiles, filesystems, images, device tree source directory, kernel options, and image size.

methods.name: Device/fsl-sdboot
methods.description: Defines device configuration for SD card boot, including kernel compression and image types.

methods.name: Device/fsl_ls1021a-twr
methods.description: Configures build parameters for the TWR-LS1021A device, including vendor, model, variant, packages, and image assembly steps.

methods.name: Device/fsl_ls1021a-twr-sdboot
methods.description: Specifies SD card boot configuration for the TWR-LS1021A, including image creation steps specific to SD card images.

methods.name: Device/fsl_ls1021a-iot-sdboot
methods.description: Defines SD card boot configuration for the LS1021A IoT device, including image creation steps.
